description: Pure library module detecting architectural patterns in MCP server tool definitions. Source: Cloudflare enterprise MCP reference architecture, blog.cloudflare.com/enterprise-mcp, 2026-04-14. Exports: detect_tool_pattern(tool_definitions: list) -> dict with keys {pattern: str, tool_count: int, evidence: dict}. Patterns: (a) progressive-disclosure: <=4 high-level tools with dynamic discovery, (b) brute-force enumeration: >=20 tools with full schemas upfront, (c) hybrid. Pure function: no DB, no network, no imports of protected modules. Include if __name__ == '__main__' self-smoke with 3 known-good inputs. Feeds future context_efficiency signal (deferred until weak-signal plateau resolved per spec).
